sections.title: Registration
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — arrival time on Day 1, Monday 7 September, where to check in, and anything participants collect on arrival. See questionnaire section 8.1.

sections.title: Meals
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — which meals are provided across the five days, and what participants arrange themselves. The programme currently shows morning tea and lunch daily, plus the gathering dinner on Wednesday 9 September.

sections.title: Getting to Cairns
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — how participants travel from Cairns Airport to their accommodation and the venue, approximate travel time, and what is covered for delegates on travel support.
TO CONFIRM — whether luggage storage is available at the venue.

sections.title: Visas and International Travel
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — this is a global gathering, so most delegates will travel internationally. Set out which Australian visa participants need, how far ahead to apply, and who to contact for a letter of invitation.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — whether children are welcome, what notice is needed for catering and access, and whether childcare is provided. Please be explicit either way; delegates plan long-haul travel around this.

sections.title: Weather and What to Pack
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — September in Cairns is tropical dry season. Include guidance on heat, sun protection and insect repellent, and a link to the local forecast. Any web address here becomes a link automatically.

sections.title: Illness Policy
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — what to do if unwell before travelling or during the gathering, and what is available on site.

sections.title: Accessibility
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — venue accessibility, interpreting and translation across languages, and who to contact about access needs. Mentioning info@thewovenproject.org turns it into a link.

sections.title: Wellbeing
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — this gathering covers land defence, dispossession and climate loss, which carry a real weight for participants with lived experience. Describe the wellbeing support available and who to approach.

sections.title: Nearby Essentials
paragraphs: TO CONFIRM — nearest pharmacy, convenience store and supermarket to the venue, with opening hours and map links.
